basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old sound engineer based in Portland, Oregon. My passion lies in curating ambient and dungeon synth playlists, which I often share on Reddit. I have a keen interest in understanding human emotions and have been exploring the concept of empathy both personally and professionally. I work freelance, which gives me flexible hours, allowing me to be online mostly during late evenings. In my downtime, I enjoy hiking the trails around Portland and delving into role-playing games. I'm currently single, and I find solace in the online communities where I can share and discuss my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Audio Engineering and have been self-teaching psychology through books and online courses. My interest in empathy stems from both personal experiences and a desire to create music that resonates emotionally with listeners.
